notes.title: [Streaming ON! Vtuber Training] Update News! (July)
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45454739/fe01d7b8a8fd5d5e6bc8c0c80af08a098560a84b.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Hello, this is Momentum Games.

It's been a while since we last spoke. 
We are pleased to announce that one of the new H scenes we previously announced has been completed and will be updated soon.

We sincerely apologize for the delay in the update due to the writer's health issues. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45454739/ea0729da2e27f0cd54127521bd5b83c75c9b556c.jpg"][/img]
Viewing requirements: Affection 100, Sexual Desire 80 Ending

We are currently working diligently with the writer to prepare the remaining three H-scenes for update. 

We will do our best to complete the remaining updates as soon as possible. 

Additionally, a free mini-game has been released, allowing you to enjoy a taste of the games previously released by Momentum Games. 

Link: [dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3773780/MOMENTUM_ART_BLAST/"][/dynamiclink]  

We hope you enjoy both the game and the work.  
If there is a work you like in the demo game, please consider bookmarking it.  

We will return with more good news in the future.  
Stay healthy.
Thank you.  

Momentum Games Team[/p]

notes.title: [Announcement] Notice about update delays
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45454739/1503ddfb92bd7da06d63d8415e8690b7a95eca8f.jpg[/img]

hello.
This is Momentum Games.

We know many of you have been waiting for an update, and we apologize for the disappointment.

Due to our lead writer's recent health issues, we've had to slow down our work.
We are working hard to recover quickly, but we realize that it will take more time than we promised.

We apologize for not sharing this sooner.

We will do our best to recover and prepare updates until the promised work is completed.

Once again, we apologize to our users for their patience.

We'll be back with more good news next time.
Thank you.

All of us at Momentum Games

notes.title: [Streaming ON! Vtuber Training] Update News! (April 7)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45454739/4982ff662647a83cf59a136b451b17bf0fd0868b.jpg[/img]
Hello. This is Momentum Games.

First of all, we would like to thank our users for their love and interest in the game. 

Since the launch of the service, we have received a lot of compliments and advice from our users, so we have been working hard internally to make various improvements.
First of all, we've released the following patches to improve gameplay, speed, and H-scenes.

We'll be updating the H-scenes with [100 likability, 80 libido] this week. 
We'll be ready to greet you with the fastest and best animations possible.  

[Fixes]
1.Added gold coin display 
- We added gold coins to the slot page.
- This was done to systematically show the gold coins shared by each slot.  

2.Save file extension - 6>9
-We've expanded the save file storage space to make it easier to view endings.

3.Health, Willpower, and Money Adjustments 
-We've significantly increased the amount of money you can earn, while lowering the health and willpower to make it more manageable.

4. Added the ability to open story endings immediately 
Added the ability to unlock story endings with in-game money.
-If you beat the main story (Red Diamond), you will receive 5 million won. 

5.Main Screen - Added the ability to view gallery directly
-Added the ability to view the gallery directly from the main screen.

6.Management, part-time job production 2x speed adjustment
-We have increased the speed of the production output in the management and part-time jobs so that you can play faster.

7.Minigame skip function added
-Added the ability to skip minigames immediately to speed up your progress. 

8.Hannah's facial expressions and movements are now separated 
-We've added a setting to change Hannah's facial expressions as you progress through the story.

We'll continue to communicate with you to make your experience even more enjoyable.

As always, we appreciate your feedback. 
All of us at Momentum

notes.title: [Streaming ON! [Vtuber Training] Update news!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45454739/732913971b219b1a9a2faae29b4e31be69ce1895.jpg[/img]
hello. This is Momentum Games.

First of all, we would like to thank many users for playing with love and interest. 

Many of you mentioned the difficulty of playing the game.
Accordingly, we have prepared the following balance and convenience patches. 

[h2][b][Improved convenience][/b][/h2]
-The acquisition conditions have been displayed in the gallery.
-The broadcast skip function has been activated from the beginning.
- During the story, the part where only the bottom panel was touched has been modified so that it can be progressed by touching the entire screen.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45454739/7de14e97a32abc0074456151a193f3d45a8a775c.jpg[/img]

[h2][b][Balance adjustment][/b][/h2]
-Reduce management costs 
Costs spent on management and gifts have been reduced. 

-Adjust gift values
We have additionally adjusted the values ​​related to sexual desire in gifts.

- Adjustment of item values
We have additionally corrected the increase in subscribers for the item.

- Adjustment of part-time job values
The cost of part-time work has been increased.

- Adjustment of number of broadcast viewers
We have additionally corrected the percentage of viewers obtained through broadcasting.

-Adjust H scene conditions
-The will part of the adult broadcast ending conditions has been removed.

[h2][b][Bug fix][/b][/h2]
-Fixed the issue where H-scenes (No. 2, Sexual Desire 100 ending) opened in the gallery could not be viewed.
-Some of the save information that was incorrect was corrected to be saved properly.


[h2][b][Other modifications][/b][/h2]
- In order to recognize the second part-time job at the bar, it has been modified to be activated after the first part-time job at the bar.
Opening conditions: 1st part-time job at a bar, sex drive over 80

-Awkward parts of the SD image have been corrected.

It was unintentional to make it too difficult to enjoy the ending, which is essential, and we have prepared it to allow you to play more comfortably. 
We will continue to communicate with you so that you can have more fun playing.

Thank you for your always valuable comments. 
Momentum All
